```
      /*
       * MaxManager motion system.
       * Motion is purposeful: short entrance choreography, responsive state changes,
       * and restrained springs. Keep motion subtle enough that hardware data remains
       * the visual priority.
       *
       * الطبقة الراقية (Premium) فوق هذا الأساس، وكلها تحت سقف `MaxDuration.deliberate` (360ms)
       * ولا شيء فيها يدور إلى الأبد (DESIGN.md §Motion):
       *  • [MaxEase] — منحنيات «مُشدَّدة» (emphasized): دخولٌ سريع وهبوطٌ ناعم، وخروجٌ يتسارع.
       *  • [maxEnter] — كشفٌ متدرّج لكتل الشاشة عند أول ظهور، يُرتَّب بموضع الكتلة على الشاشة لا برقم.
       *  • [rememberMaxHaptics] — اهتزازٌ لمسيّ واحد لكل فعل (تبديل · خطوة · اختيار) بدل نداءات متفرّقة.
       */
      package nd.max.ui.component
      
      import androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility
      import androidx.compose.animation.EnterTransition
      import androidx.compose.animation.ExitTransition
      import androidx.compose.animation.core.FastOutSlowInEasing
      import androidx.compose.animation.core.Spring
      import androidx.compose.animation.core.spring
      import androidx.compose.animation.core.tween
      import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateFloatAsState
      import androidx.compose.animation.fadeIn
      import androidx.compose.animation.fadeOut
      import androidx.compose.animation.slideInVertically
      import androidx.compose.animation.slideOutVertically
      import androidx.compose.foundation.interaction.MutableInteractionSource
      import androidx.compose.foundation.interaction.collectIsPressedAsState
      import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
      import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
      import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
      import androidx.compose.animation.core.Animatable
      import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
      import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
      import androidx.compose.ui.unit.IntSize
      import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
      import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.graphicsLayer
      import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
      import android.content.Context
      import android.provider.Settings
      import androidx.compose.animation.core.CubicBezierEasing
      import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyItemScope
      import androidx.compose.ui.unit.IntOffset
      import androidx.compose.runtime.Stable
      import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
      import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable
      import androidx.compose.runtime.snapshots.Snapshot
      import androidx.compose.ui.hapticfeedback.HapticFeedback
      import androidx.compose.ui.hapticfeedback.HapticFeedbackType
      import androidx.compose.ui.layout.onGloballyPositioned
      import androidx.compose.ui.layout.positionInWindow
      import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalConfiguration
      import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalDensity
      import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalHapticFeedback
      import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
      import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
      import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
      import nd.max.ui.design.MaxDuration
      import nd.max.ui.design.MaxSpace
      import nd.max.ui.theme.ThemeStudio
      
      object MaxMotion {
          const val fast = 160
          const val standard = 260
          const val emphasis = 420
      
          /** Snappier spring for small controls (switches, pills, chevrons). */
          val controlSpring = spring<Float>(
              dampingRatio = Spring.DampingRatioLowBouncy,
              stiffness = Spring.StiffnessMedium
          )
      
          val contentSpring = spring<IntSize>(
              dampingRatio = Spring.DampingRatioNoBouncy,
              stiffness = Spring.StiffnessMediumLow
          )
      
          /** Spring with a touch of overshoot for needle-like value changes. */
          val needleSpring = spring<Float>(
              dampingRatio = Spring.DampingRatioMediumBouncy,
              stiffness = Spring.StiffnessLow
          )
      
          fun enter(delayMillis: Int = 0): EnterTransition =
              fadeIn(
                  animationSpec = tween(
                      durationMillis = standard,
                      delayMillis = delayMillis,
                      easing = FastOutSlowInEasing
                  )
              ) + slideInVertically(
                  animationSpec = tween(
                      durationMillis = standard,
                      delayMillis = delayMillis,
                      easing = FastOutSlowInEasing
                  ),
                  initialOffsetY = { it / 14 }
              )
      
          val exit: ExitTransition =
              fadeOut(animationSpec = tween(fast, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)) +
                  slideOutVertically(
                      animationSpec = tween(fast, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
                      targetOffsetY = { -it / 18 }
                  )
      }
      
      /**
       * هل أوقف المستخدم حركات النظام؟ (`Settings.Global.ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE == 0`).
       *
       * يُقرأ مرّة عند التركيب لا في كل إطار: هو تفضيل نظام يُقلَّب في الإعدادات، ومن غيّره يعيد
       * فتح الشاشة فيُعاد التركيب. والقراءة مغلّفة بـ`runCatching` لأن مزوّد الإعدادات قد يحجب
       * المفتاح على بعض البنيات — وحجبُه ليس «الحركة مطلوبة»، بل «لا نعرف»، والمجهول هنا يُحلّ إلى
       * السلوك المعتاد لا إلى إسقاط حركة لم يطلبها أحد.
       */
      @Composable
      fun rememberAnimationsEnabled(): Boolean {
          val context = LocalContext.current
          return remember(context) {
              runCatching {
                  Settings.Global.getFloat(
                      context.contentResolver,
                      Settings.Global.ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE,
                      1f
                  ) != 0f
              }.getOrDefault(true)
          }
      }
      
      /**
       * هل تأثيرات التمرير مطلوبة الآن؟ = **تفضيل المستخدم** ∧ **حركة النظام مفتوحة**.
       *
       * وهي البوابة الواحدة التي تمرّ بها [MaxReveal] و[Modifier.maxEnter] و[Modifier.maxItemMotion]:
       * مفتاح واحد في شاشة التخصيص يوقفها في كل موضع مربوط، فلا يبقى مؤثّر شارد يعمل بعد «أوقفتُها».
       *
       * **وقراءتها واحدة عند التركيب** كقراءة تفضيل النظام نفسها: من قلّب المفتاح يعيد فتح الشاشة
       * فيُعاد التركيب — وهي نفس المعادلة القائمة في `rememberAnimationsEnabled`، فلا مساران
       * لقراءة تفضيل واحد.
       */
      @Composable
      fun rememberScrollEffectsEnabled(): Boolean {
          val context = LocalContext.current
          val systemAllows = rememberAnimationsEnabled()
          val userAllows = remember(context) {
              runCatching {
                  ThemeStudio.scrollEffects(
                      context.getSharedPreferences(SETTINGS_PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                  )
              }.getOrDefault(true)
          }
          return systemAllows && userAllows
      }
      
      /** اسم ملفّ التفضيلات الذي يكتب فيه التطبيق خيارات الإعدادات (والثيم) — نصًّا واحدًا. */
      private const val SETTINGS_PREFS = "settings"
      
      /**
       * A restrained reveal used for dashboard blocks and settings groups.
       *
       * **ويحترم إيقاف الحركة في النظام:** من أوقف الحركات (`ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE = 0`) يُعرض له
       * المحتوى كما هو بلا fade ولا إزاحة — لا «حركة أسرع». وهذا شرط خطة المستوى (`DESIGN.md`:
       * "احترم Reduce Motion")، وكان غير مطبَّق: الـAPI كان يُنادي `animateTo` بلا سؤال.
       */
      @Composable
      fun MaxReveal(
          visible: Boolean = true,
          delayMillis: Int = 0,
          modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
          content: @Composable () -> Unit
      ) {
          if (!rememberScrollEffectsEnabled()) {
              if (visible) content()
              return
          }
          val entrance = remember { Animatable(0f) }
          LaunchedEffect(visible) {
              if (visible) {
                  entrance.animateTo(
                      1f,
                      tween(MaxMotion.standard, delayMillis.coerceIn(0, 160), FastOutSlowInEasing)
                  )
              } else {
                  entrance.snapTo(0f)
              }
          }
          AnimatedVisibility(
              visible = visible,
              modifier = modifier.graphicsLayer {
                  alpha = entrance.value
                  translationY = (1f - entrance.value) * 12.dp.toPx()
              },
              enter = EnterTransition.None,
              exit = MaxMotion.exit
          ) {
              content()
          }
      }
      
      
      /** Responsive press feedback shared by interactive MaxManager surfaces. */
      @Composable
      fun Modifier.maxPressMotion(
          interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource,
          pressedScale: Float = 0.98f
      ): Modifier {
          val pressed by interactionSource.collectIsPressedAsState()
          val scale by animateFloatAsState(
              targetValue = if (pressed) pressedScale else 1f,
              animationSpec = MaxMotion.controlSpring,
              label = "pressScale"
          )
          return graphicsLayer {
              scaleX = scale
              scaleY = scale
          }
      }
      
      /** Tiny settle motion for values that change without changing layout. */
      fun Modifier.maxValueMotion(scale: Float = 1f, alpha: Float = 1f): Modifier =
          graphicsLayer {
              scaleX = scale
              scaleY = scale
              this.alpha = alpha
          }
      
      
      // ───────────────────────────── الطبقة الراقية ─────────────────────────────
      
      /**
       * منحنيات التسارع «المُشدَّدة» (Material 3 emphasized).
       *
       * `FastOutSlowIn` يبدأ وينتهي بالتوازن نفسه، فيبدو الدخول «ميكانيكيًّا». هذه المنحنيات تفرّق بين
       * **ما يظهر** (يندفع ثم يهبط ببطء ← يشعر المستخدم أن العنصر «وصل») و**ما يغادر** (يتردّد لحظة ثم
       * ينصرف بسرعة ← لا يُعطّل النظر). والفرق محسوس عند ٢٤٠ms رغم أنه لا يُرى كحركة مستقلّة.
       */
      object MaxEase {
          /** لكل ما **يدخل**: انطلاقة سريعة وهبوط طويل ناعم. */
          val EmphasizedDecelerate = CubicBezierEasing(0.05f, 0.7f, 0.1f, 1f)
      
          /** لكل ما **يغادر**: بداية متمهّلة ثم انصراف سريع. */
          val EmphasizedAccelerate = CubicBezierEasing(0.3f, 0f, 0.8f, 0.15f)
      
          /** لما يتحرّك **داخل الشاشة نفسها** (مؤشّر منزلق، تغيّر حجم): يأخذ وقته في النهاية. */
          val Emphasized = CubicBezierEasing(0.2f, 0f, 0f, 1f)
      }
      
      /**
       * أقصى تأخير يناله بلوك في أسفل الشاشة المرئية.
       *
       * ١١٠ + [MaxDuration.standard] (٢٤٠) = ٣٥٠ms، أي **تحت** سقف [MaxDuration.deliberate] (٣٦٠):
       * الحركة كلها تنتهي قبل أن تتحوّل إلى زخرفة.
       */
      private const val MaxEnterStaggerMillis = 110
      
      /**
       * كشف متدرّج للكتلة عند أول ظهورها: شفافية + صعود قصير، **مرّة واحدة** لكل كتلة.
       *
       * **لماذا بالموضع لا بالرقم.** الكتل هنا تُكتب في ٤٠ شاشة بأيدٍ مختلفة؛ ترقيمها يدويًّا (١، ٢، ٣…)
       * يعني أن كل من يضيف قسمًا يعدّل أرقام غيره، وأن قسمًا يُحذف يترك فجوة في الإيقاع. فالتأخير هنا
       * **يُشتقّ من ارتفاع الكتلة على الشاشة**: الأعلى أولًا والأسفل بعده، فيتولّد تتابعٌ طبيعي مهما
       * كان ترتيب الكتابة. وما كان **تحت حافة الشاشة** يظهر فورًا بلا حركة — فلا يُمثَّل عرضٌ لا يراه أحد،
       * وعند التمرير تجد الكتلة نفسها كاملة.
       *
       * **لا تُعاد.** حالة «دخلت» محفوظة بـ`rememberSaveable`: تدوير الجهاز، أو عودة صفّ إلى قائمة
       * كسولة بعد خروجه منها، لا يُعيدان الحركة. وتُقرأ **بلا تتبّع** ([Snapshot.withoutReadObservation])
       * لأن قراءتها في التركيب كانت ستُعيد تركيب القسم كله عند انتهاء الحركة — ثمن لا يُشترى بحركة.
       *
       * **ويحترم إيقاف الحركة** ([rememberAnimationsEnabled]): تُرسم الكتلة كاملة بلا أي معدِّل إضافي.
       * وكل ما فيها يجري في مرحلة الرسم (`graphicsLayer`)، فلا إعادة تركيب ولا إعادة قياس في أي إطار.
       *
       * @param travel المسافة التي تصعدها الكتلة. افتراضيًّا [MaxSpace.md]: كافية لتُفهَم، أقلّ من أن تُلاحَظ.
       */
      @Composable
      fun Modifier.maxEnter(travel: Dp = MaxSpace.md): Modifier {
          val animationsEnabled = rememberScrollEffectsEnabled()
          val entered = rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
          val progress = remember {
              val alreadyEntered = Snapshot.withoutReadObservation { entered.value }
              Animatable(if (animationsEnabled && !alreadyEntered) 0f else 1f)
          }
          val placedAtY = remember { CompletableDeferred<Float>() }
          val screenHeightPx = with(LocalDensity.current) {
              LocalConfiguration.current.screenHeightDp.dp.toPx()
          }
      
          LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
              if (progress.value < 1f) {
                  val y = placedAtY.await()
                  if (y >= screenHeightPx) {
                      // تحت الحافة: لا مُشاهد لها الآن، فلا حركة.
                      progress.snapTo(1f)
                  } else {
                      val staggerMillis = (y / screenHeightPx).coerceIn(0f, 1f) * MaxEnterStaggerMillis
                      delay(staggerMillis.toLong())
                      progress.animateTo(
                          targetValue = 1f,
                          animationSpec = tween(MaxDuration.standard, easing = MaxEase.EmphasizedDecelerate)
                      )
                  }
              }
              entered.value = true
          }
      
          return if (!animationsEnabled) {
              this
          } else {
              this
                  // قبل `graphicsLayer` عن قصد: الموضع المقيس هو موضع الاستقرار، لا موضعٌ أزاحته حركتنا نفسها.
                  .onGloballyPositioned { coordinates ->
                      if (!placedAtY.isCompleted) placedAtY.complete(coordinates.positionInWindow().y)
                  }
                  .graphicsLayer {
                      val p = progress.value
                      alpha = p
                      translationY = (1f - p) * travel.toPx()
                  }
          }
      }
      
      /**
       * اهتزاز لمسيّ **واحد** لكل فعل، بمعنًى واحد في كل التطبيق.
       *
       * كان الاهتزاز موزّعًا بنداءات خام (`TextHandleMove` في موضعين، `LongPress` في موضع) فلا يعرف من
       * يضيف مفتاحًا أيّ نوع يختار. هنا الفعل هو الاسم، والنوع التفصيلي يُقرَّر في مكان واحد:
       * لو احتاج نوعٌ إلى تبديل، يتغيّر هنا لا في كل شاشة.
       *
       * النظام نفسه هو من يحترم تفضيل المستخدم «ردّ الفعل اللمسي»؛ لا نتجاوزه.
       */
      @Stable
      class MaxHaptics internal constructor(private val feedback: HapticFeedback) {
          /** مفتاح تبديل: نبضة «تشغيل» مختلفة عن «إيقاف»، فتُعرف الحالة الجديدة باللمس وحده. */
          fun toggle(on: Boolean) {
              feedback.performHapticFeedback(
                  if (on) HapticFeedbackType.ToggleOn else HapticFeedbackType.ToggleOff
              )
          }
      
          /** تغيّر اختيار بين بدائل (تبويب · شريط تنقّل · خيار حصريّ). */
          fun select() {
              feedback.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.TextHandleMove)
          }
      
          /** عبور خطوة منفصلة على شريط تمرير. */
          fun step() {
              feedback.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.SegmentTick)
          }
      }
      
      @Composable
      fun rememberMaxHaptics(): MaxHaptics {
          val feedback = LocalHapticFeedback.current
          return remember(feedback) { MaxHaptics(feedback) }
      }
      
      /**
       * حركة صفّ في قائمة كسولة: ينزلق إلى موضعه الجديد، ويظهر/يغيب بنعومة عند التصفية والبحث.
       *
       * بلا هذا يقفز كل صفّ تحت العنصر المحذوف إلى مكانه في إطار واحد، فيفقد المستخدم موضع عينه
       * وسط قائمة طويلة. يُستعمل فقط حيث للصفّ **مفتاح ثابت** وحيث الصفّ **عنصر جذر واحد**: صفٌّ يتبعه
       * فاصل خارج جذره ينزلق وحده ويترك الفاصل يقفز — وهذا أسوأ من بلا حركة.
       *
       * ولا يُوضَع على قوائم تتبدّل ترتيبًا كل ثانية (العمليات، السجلّ الحيّ): هناك الحركة المستمرّة
       * ضجيج يُخفي القراءة، وهو مناقض لقاعدة «الحركة تشرح تغيّرًا لا تُزيّن».
       */
      @Composable
      fun LazyItemScope.maxItemMotion(): Modifier =
          if (rememberScrollEffectsEnabled()) {
              Modifier.animateItem(
                  fadeInSpec = tween(MaxDuration.standard, easing = MaxEase.EmphasizedDecelerate),
                  placementSpec = spring<IntOffset>(
                      dampingRatio = Spring.DampingRatioNoBouncy,
                      stiffness = Spring.StiffnessMediumLow
                  ),
                  fadeOutSpec = tween(MaxDuration.quick, easing = MaxEase.EmphasizedAccelerate),
              )
          } else {
              Modifier
          }
      
```

> _Reasoning_
> `rememberAnimationsEnabled()` only reads ANIMATOR_DURATION_SCALE, not power save mode. The user asks Battery Saver to reduce activity. We could extend it to include `PowerManager.isPowerSaveMode` so decorative infinite animations stop when battery saver is on. But note the app's own "battery saver" might be a different toggle (inside MaxManager). Let's find the app's Battery Saver setting.
> 
> Search for battery saver in settings/UI.

```json
  "maxResults": 40
}
```

```
                  Shell.cmd("settings put global low_power $value").exec()
                  var live = Shell.cmd("settings get global low_power").exec().out.joinToString("").trim()
                  if (live != value) {
```

> _Reasoning_
> OK, screens poll at 3s while shown. Fine-ish.
> 
> I think I need to decide and act. But before fixing, one more important area: `HardwareControlArbiter` and drift reassertion, `applyPerAppConfig` — these write CPU/GPU repeatedly. The requirement asks "don't rewrite hardware if already at desired value". Let me check `HardwareControlArbiter` and whether verifyAndRepair writes unnecessarily. Also check `ProfileApplier` writing max frequencies.
> 
> Actually — crucial: **`AppMonitor.reassertDriftedKnobs` runs every 10s while a managed app is foreground. It calls `hardwareControlRegistry.verifyAndRepair()`** which reads live values for every owned knob and rewrites when drifted. If `verifyAndRepair` re-writes even when desired == live (bug), that's continuous writes. Logs show only 63 APPLY_DRIFT_REPAIRED in 6 days, so it's not rewriting constantly. Good.
> 
> So the remaining continuous load in the companion is the poll loop + status/background reads. Let me quantify the companion's idle CPU from logs? Not available. But `AppMonitor` writes `app_status` only on change; with `switch_id` constant and battery TTL, changes are rare when idle. But `writeBackgroundApps` computes `runningAppProcesses` + `getRecentTasks` each second when screen on — two heavy Binder calls. That's continuous while screen is on, even if nothing changes. This is a definite, fixable inefficiency: cache the heavy query for a longer interval (e.g., only when status changes or every 10-30s), and skip entirely when no managed app is active/foreground since the file only matters for the game path.
> 
> Wait — is `background_apps` needed? It's read by `handle_background_apps_event` in daemon, for "background apps" feature? Let me check its consumer and the file semantics.
> 
> Also `writeStatus` every 1s calls `getFocusedAppInfo` (reflection on ActivityManager.getTasks → heavy Binder), plus `getZenMode` (NotificationManager binder), `getAppName` (PM cache), refresh rate display, battery broadcast. That's a lot per second but they're mostly cheap; `getTasks(1)` is moderately heavy.
> 
> For a monitor that's idle, 1s cadence with 2 heavy binder calls is not "almost invisible". The app promises 0% CPU when idle. So we should:
> - Make `CompanionPollPolicy` idle cadence much slower (e.g., 3-5s screen-on idle, 15s screen-off) — but the user says don't break detection of game start. The game start path is essential (per-app profile). We could instead switch to an event-driven foreground detection for the companion (UsageStats/Accessibility not available to root companion? It has ActivityManager). Hmm.
>

```
      /*
       * Copyright (C) 2026 Nader Magdy. All rights reserved.
       * Proprietary and confidential — not licensed for use, copying, or distribution
       * without prior written permission from the copyright holder.
       */
      
      #include <MaxManager.h>
      
      /**
       * الوضع الواحد: قرارات نقيّة تُقاس على المضيف، وقراءة واحدة للملفّ/الخاصية.
       *
       * لماذا ملفّ جديد بدل تعديل `ProfileUtility.c`: `ProfileUtility.c` يملك كتابة
       * `current_profile` (الوضع الفاعل)، وهذا الملفّ يملك **نيّة المستخدم** فقط.
       * الفصل هو ما يمنع وضع اللعبة المؤقّت من أن يصير «اختيار المستخدم» عند الإقلاع
       * التالي. والدوال هنا بلا `fopen` في اختبارات القرار النقيّ.
       */
      
      ProfileMode max_ai_mode_from_saved(int saved) {
          if (saved >= PERFORMANCE_PROFILE && saved <= ECO_MODE)
              return (ProfileMode)saved;
          return BALANCED_PROFILE;
      }
      
      ProfileMode max_ai_mode_from_objective(const char* objective) {
          if (objective != NULL && strcmp(objective, "performance") == 0)
              return PERFORMANCE_PROFILE;
          if (objective != NULL && strcmp(objective, "battery") == 0)
              return ECO_MODE;
          return BALANCED_PROFILE;
      }
      
      /**
       * @brief هل يُطبَّق وضع أساس عند هذه الحالة؟
       * @return الوضع المطلوب، أو `PERFCOMMON` حين يكون Max AI مطفأً (لا ملفّ إقلاع).
       *
       * `PERFCOMMON` هنا علامة «لا تُطبّق» لا ملفّ رابع؛ الخادم يستعمله أصلًا للتهيئة
       * (`run_profiler(0)`)، ولا يعني وضعًا للمستخدم.
       */
      ProfileMode max_ai_mode_resolve(bool ai_enabled, int saved, const char* objective) {
          if (!ai_enabled)
              return PERFCOMMON;
          if (saved >= PERFORMANCE_PROFILE && saved <= ECO_MODE)
              return (ProfileMode)saved;
          return max_ai_mode_from_objective(objective);
      }
      
      /**
       * @brief يقرأ نيّة المستخدم: الملفّ أولًا، ثم `AIobjective` القديم، ثم Balanced.
       *
       * القراءة لا تحكم هل يُطبَّق؛ `System.c` يسأل `prev_ai_state` قبل التطبيق. فالملفّ
       * يبقى محفوظًا حتى لو كان AI مطفأً، ويُطبَّق عند تشغيله.
       */
      ProfileMode max_ai_mode_read(void) {
          int saved = -1;
          FILE* fp = fopen(MAX_AI_MODE, "r");
          if (fp != NULL) {
              char value[16] = {0};
              if (fgets(value, sizeof(value), fp) != NULL)
                  saved = atoi(value);
              fclose(fp);
          }
      
          if (saved >= PERFORMANCE_PROFILE && saved <= ECO_MODE)
              return (ProfileMode)saved;
      
          char objective[PROP_VALUE_MAX] = {0};
          __system_property_get("persist.sys.maxmanagerconf.AIobjective", objective);
          return max_ai_mode_from_objective(objective);
      }
      
      /** مرآة الهدف: تُكتب مع الوضع ليبقى الإشعار والخصائص القديمة متوافقة. */
      const char* max_ai_objective_for_mode(ProfileMode mode) {
          switch (mode) {
              case PERFORMANCE_PROFILE:
                  return "performance";
              case ECO_MODE:
                  return "battery";
              case BALANCED_PROFILE:
              default:
                  return "balanced";
          }
      }
```

> _Reasoning_
> Bug candidate: `cur_mode` initialized to `PERFCOMMON` (0) — which is not one of IMPLEMENTED modes; then at boot if AI is on and `max_ai_mode`=ECO, `apply_eco_profile` applies. If AI is **off**, the daemon `continue`s at line: `if (ctx.is_initialize_complete && strcmp(ctx.prev_ai_state, "0") == 0) continue;` — so no profile applied. So the saved Battery mode stays as intent. Good.
> 
> But: `current_profile` may hold old active mode. On boot, `cur_mode` = 0. When a tracked game comes to foreground while AI is **off**, `apply_performance_profile` is called (regardless of ai). Then on leaving game, `apply_base_profile` uses `ctx.base_mode` which was read from `max_ai_mode` at boot = ECO. So battery mode is respected. Good.
>

So the service could stop itself when not in a game and be restarted by the companion on game switch. But P2 says without root the service must stay alive.
>   (d) Keep service alive but in **idle mode poll at a much longer interval** and use `UsageStatsManager` for cheap foreground detection (binder, no process spawn), falling back to shell only at a slower cadence when usage access is missing. Usage stats is granted (the user is root, but usage access is a separate permission; still could check).
>   Actually simplest and strongest: replace the per-poll `dumpsys` with a **cheap `ActivityManager.getRunningTasks(1)`**? Deprecated/blocked on Android 14 for non-system apps, and the app process is not root (the service runs in app UID), so no.

That reduces idle wakeups 5x and screen-off wakeups to zero (event-driven). Combined with a `GameForeground` cache TTL that is >= poll interval, fewer shell calls.

If AI is off and `AIobjective` is "balanced" while `max_ai_mode` missing → writes Balanced (2), overwriting nothing. Fine.
> - Policy: `MaxAiDutyCycle.fast` uses 1s or 5s. When AI enabled with Battery objective, the fast safety loop still runs 1s — necessary for safety? The safety engine thresholds 48/52 with 1s sampling. Could be kept. But maybe add: battery objective reduces cycle frequency from 30s to 60s? The cycle already only acts when a gap. Not needed.
> - **Real bug candidate**: `MaxAiEngine` when aiEnabled false only runs `emergencyGuardTick()` (reads battery temp via `ThermalUtil` every 15s) — fine.
> - `applyProfile` from UI writes `max_ai_mode`, then `ProfileApplier.applyFromAi(profileId)`. If AI is off, `apply()` (manual). Fine.
> 
> ### 5. 250% CPU when app open — infinite decorative animations
> - `rememberAnimationsEnabled` doesn't respect system battery saver (only animation scale). There are many infinite transitions. On a 120Hz screen, the lobby has a single loop; but other screens (CubeParts spinner, CyberAudioVortex, LiveGraph shimmer, MaxInk, NeuralSparkline, island equalizer) each may run infinite transitions; when a screen has several, CPU/GPU cost adds up. And `beyondViewportPageCount` composes neighbor pages with loops.
> - **Fix (single point)**: extend `rememberAnimationsEnabled()` to return false when `PowerManager.isPowerSaveMode` is true, and set up `DisposableEffect` to listen for power-save changes? Simpler: read at composition. The requirement says "when Battery Saver enabled, reduce UI updates". This is a concrete, minimal change. But many infinite transitions don't use `rememberAnimationsEnabled` at all (only some do). We should audit which don't, and gate the heavy ones.
>

> _Reasoning_
> Findings:
> - `LiveGraphComponent` shimmer has NO animations-enabled gate → infinite transition always.
> - `DeckDisc` (CockpitDeck) pulse always.
> - `GamePanelHandle` uses `live` only (probably fine, only while game).
> - `MaxInk` loop always (maybe used in settings).
> - `IslandParts` animated param.
> 
> If `rememberAnimationsEnabled` also considered power-save, it would fix many but not LiveGraph/DeckDisc/MaxInk. Extend those too.
> 
> But 250% CPU? Infinite transitions on tiny elements are cheap. Not the main cause.
> 
> Let me look for a real runaway: `rememberInfiniteTransition` + `Modifier.blur`? no blur. `Canvas` drawing a full-screen starfield at 60fps? `MaxOrbitScene` does with `withFrameNanos` — full-screen Canvas with radial gradient stars. That runs on the home screen (`flowing` default true, `animationsEnabled && !powerSave && onScreen`). Note powerSave is read once at composition. The home screen likely includes 2-3 orbit scenes? Let me check usage. And `LobbyStage` breathing loop + offscreen pager.
> 
> Actually, let's check the main screen composition: `StoryboardHome` — huge. It might render 12 infinite loops simultaneously. On a 120Hz display, CPU could hover 50-100%. Still not 250%.
> 
> A 250% figure may be a momentary spike when opening the app (package manager scanning 500 apps, loading icons, Atlas probing hardware). The user may have measured during app open and general use. "500MB RAM" also app-open.
> 
> Given the ask, the best deliverable is:
> 1. Evidence-based identification of the always-on work paths (companion, panel service, Max AI, animations, battery saver inert).
> 2. Concrete fixes for the biggest ones.
> 3. Tests for policy functions.
> 4. Honest report with limitations (no device, no profiling).
> 
> Let me dig a bit more to find hard, provable defects rather than tuning:
> 
> (a) **`FpsMonitorUtil.getForegroundPackage` cache bug**: if the resolved package is empty, it doesn't update `foregroundCachedAtMs`, so every call retries up to 3 `su` commands back-to-back. In the panel service when the screen is off, calls are skipped. When screen is on and dumpsys fails (e.g., SELinux/RootFileAccess issue), every 2s = 3 shell spawns. Also `getForegroundPackage()` uses libsu `Shell.cmd` from **the app process** even though `RootFileAccess` (root node service) exists. The companion's shellForeground uses `RootFileAccess.readCommand` (binder) which is cheaper. So the panel service could use `RootFileAccess.readCommand` through the shared root service, avoiding a new `su` process. That's a concrete cost saver, but requires care.
> 
> (b) **`GamePanelService.poll` doesn't skip work when screen off**: it still calls `GamePanelPrefs.load`, `CrosshairPrefs.load`, `AppLanguage.savedTag`, `refreshLibraryIfNeeded`, `placeWindow`, `syncCrosshair`, even though `foreground = null` and state → Unknown. Actually it does collapse the panel first time, then keeps executing `placeWindow()` every 10s and `syncCrosshair` etc. Minor.
> 
> (c) **`GamePanelService` is started via root shell `am start-foreground-service` on every game switch** (SIDE_PANEL_START 91 / START_RESULT 91). The companion does this in `maybeStartSidePanel(pkg, screenAwake)` on each app switch. If the service is already running, this starts it again (bind? startService with intent) — cheap-ish but each `am` spawn is a process. 91 in 12 days is negligible.
> 
> (d) **`InAppProfileApplier.sync` is called after every poll** and in non-root mode does `ExecutionModeStore.current()` and reads `PrivilegeManager.cachedRootGranted`. Cheap.
> 
> (e) **The daemon's `need_profile_checkup` on every `app_status` write**: This re-applies the performance profile for a tracked app on **any** status change, including battery level changes (every ~1% ≈ every few minutes while gaming) and refresh-rate changes. Each re-apply spawns `sys.maxmanager-service --profile 1`? Actually `run_profiler` in-process? `EXECUTE` macro probably runs the profiler in-process or via binary. `MaxManager_Profiler` log lines come from a separate process (the profiler binary), so each apply spawns a process and writes dozens of sysfs nodes. During a game, battery level ticks cause extra full profile application — CPU + heat + battery. This is a concrete bug: `app_status` includes battery_level/battery_saver/refresh_rate etc., and the daemon treats the file as "profile checkup needed". The fix: only set `need_profile_checkup = true` when the **focused app / switch id** changed, i.e., parse app_status and compare focused_app; or the companion should write a separate signal for app switch. This is C code, testable via parity_test.
> 
> Let's verify: In the debug log, look at consecutive PROFILE_APPLY PERFORMANCE for the same target without an APP_SWITCH between. If yes → the bug is real. Count pairs.

> _Reasoning_
> Now I see the state machine. In the `need_profile_checkup` branch with no game:
> 
> ```
> if (ctx.cur_mode != BALANCED_PROFILE && ctx.cur_mode != ECO_MODE)
>     ctx.need_profile_checkup = false;
> ...
> apply_performance_profile(&ctx);  // at end of the branch
> ```
> 
> So whenever `need_profile_checkup` is set while the focused app is not a tracked game, and `cur_mode` is PERFORMANCE, it sets need_profile_checkup=false (to allow...), then **still calls `apply_performance_profile`** — which re-applies performance **with no game** (target=system)! That is exactly the logged repeated `PROFILE_APPLY profile=PERFORMANCE target=system` at 07:14, 08:05, etc. The guard at the top of `apply_performance_profile` is:
> 
> ```
> if (ctx->is_initialize_complete && ctx->cur_mode == PERFORMANCE_PROFILE && !ctx->need_profile_checkup) return;
> ```
> 
> Since `need_profile_checkup` was just set false in that branch, the guard should return... Wait, in the no-game branch they set `need_profile_checkup = false` only if `cur_mode != BALANCED && != ECO`, i.e., when cur_mode == PERFORMANCE or 0. Then `apply_performance_profile` sees cur_mode == PERFORMANCE and !need_profile_checkup → returns. So no log. But logs show `PROFILE_APPLY target=system` — so at those moments `cur_mode` was not PERFORMANCE (e.g., ECO/BALANCED because battery saver or screen off changed it), or `is_initialize_complete` false.
> 
> If `cur_mode` was BALANCED/ECO (line: `if (ctx.cur_mode != BALANCED && != ECO) need=false;` leaves need=true), then `apply_performance_profile` runs with `gamestart == NULL` → **applies Performance to the whole system** and logs target=system. That's a bug: when the focused app is *not* a tracked game, the daemon should apply the **base** profile, not Performance.
> 
> Look at the flow: `if (ctx.need_profile_checkup) { ... apply_performance_profile(&ctx); }` — unconditionally at the end of the checkup branch, even when no game was found. So every `app_status` write (which sets need_profile_checkup) causes a performance profile application if `cur_mode` is not PERFORMANCE... Actually if cur_mode == PERFORMANCE it's a no-op (guard). If cur_mode is BALANCED (normal base), then any app_status write re-applies PERFORMANCE globally, and then the next loop's base condition may apply BALANCED again (since cur_mode == PERFORMANCE and gamestart==NULL and !need... → continue? Let's trace):

```
      /**
       * لوحة «النشاط الحالي» — تحكي **أثر اختياراتك** بجمل مفهومة، وتقع تحت بطاقتَي CPU وGPU مباشرة (طلب المالك).
       *
       * ما تعرضه، بالترتيب:
       * 1. ملخّصٌ من سطر: كم مُطبَّقًا، وكم محجوزًا، وكم فشل — فلا يحتاج القارئ إلى عدّ الأسطر.
       * 2. الأسطر: كل مقبض بعنوانه الواضح (ومعه عنقود المعالج إن وُجد)، وقيمته جملةً («من … إلى …»)،
       *    وسببه بلغة بشرية إن لم يُطبَّق.
       * 3. كل سطر باب: يفتح شاشة صاحب المقبض، فلا قيمة تُقرأ بلا مكان تُضبط فيه.
       * 4. إن لم يوجد شيء تقول البطاقة ذلك صراحةً، ولا تختفي.
       *
       * القاعدة باقية: لا رقم يُخترع هنا. والصياغة (من/إلى، النطاق، أسماء الملفات) في `ActivityFormat` و`StoryboardModel`.
       */
      @Composable
      internal fun UnifiedActivityCard(
          maxAi: MaxAiState,
          modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
          onNavigate: (String) -> Unit = {},
      ) {
          val context = LocalContext.current
          val state by produceState(initialValue = CardState()) {
              while (true) {
                  value = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                      CardState(
                          scenes = StoryboardSources.scenes(context),
                          options = ActivityCardPreferences.read(context),
                      )
                  }
                  delay(STORYBOARD_REFRESH_MS)
              }
          }
          // الترتيب والحذف والتكرار والحدّ والشكل: كلّها في النموذج المختبر، لا في هذه الدالة.
          val model = UnifiedActivityModel.build(
              scenes = StoryboardModel.storyboard(state.scenes + maxAiSceneFrom(maxAi)),
              options = state.options,
              nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis(),
          )
      
          val palette = neuralPalette()
          val scheme = MaterialTheme.colorScheme
          CompositionLocalProvider(LocalActivityNavigate provides onNavigate) {
              NeuralPanel(modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth(), accent = palette.accent) {
                  NeuralSectionHeader(
                      title = stringResource(R.string.home_activity_title),
                      caption = stringResource(R.string.home_activity_caption),
                      accent = palette.accent,
                  )
                  if (model.isEmpty) {
                      ActivityEmpty(palette)
                  } else {
                      ActivitySummary(model.scenes.flatMap { it.lines }, palette)
                      SceneBody(model, model.scenes.first(), scheme, palette)
                      // ما تبقّى: مُرشَّح سلفًا (لا تكرار مع المشهد الأول)، ومحدود برصيد البطاقة، وبشكله.
                      val rest = model.scenes.drop(1)
                      when (model.style) {
                          UnifiedActivityModel.CardStyle.CHIPS -> {
                              for (pair in rest.flatMap { it.lines }.chunked(2)) {
                                  Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                                      for (line in pair) {
                                          SceneChip(line, model.showReason, scheme, Modifier.weight(1f))
                                      }
                                  }
                              }
                          }

          }

                  }

                          CubeProbe(

                      fpsOverlay = FpsOverlayService.isRunning
                  }
                  delay(800)
              }
          }
      
          LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
              while (true) {
                  delay(1000)
                  // قائمة مفتوحة أو تنفيذ جارٍ = المستخدم يعمل؛ لا طيّ تحت يده.
                  if (menu == CubeMenu.None && thermalNow.phase != ThermalPhase.Applying &&
                      CockpitModel.shouldCollapseIdle(android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis(), activeAt)
                  ) {
                      if (!leaving) {
                          leaving = true
                          enter.animateTo(0f, tween(LEAVE_MS))
                          onCollapse()
                      }
                      break
                  }
              }
          }
      
          fun leave(after: () -> Unit) {
              if (leaving) return
              leaving = true
              scope.launch {
                  enter.animateTo(0f, tween(LEAVE_MS))
                  after()
              }
          }
      
          fun say(text: String) {
              notes.add(text)
              while (notes.size > 3) notes.removeAt(0)
              scope.launch { delay(4200); notes.remove(text) }
          }
      
          fun hold() { holdUntil = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 1600 }
```

```
      /*
       * Copyright (C) 2026 Nader Magdy. All rights reserved.
       * Proprietary and confidential — not licensed for use, copying, or distribution
       * without prior written permission from the copyright holder.
       */
      /*
       * مصادر لوحة «ما يحدث الآن» — الطبقة الوحيدة التي تعرف **من أين** يُقرأ كل سطر.
       *
       * لماذا وُجد هذا الملف
       * --------------------
       * `StoryboardModel` قرّر **كيف يُبنى** السطر، وهو خالص ومُقاس في JVM. وما بقي هو الطرف الآخر:
       * ترجمة المصادر الحقيقية (سجل نتائج العتاد، ملف اختياراتك، أقفالك اليدوية، عبارة التطبيق) إلى
       * أنواع اللوحة. ووضع هذه الترجمة هنا لا في الشاشة مقصود: الشاشة تُركّب، وهذا الملف **يقرأ** —
       * فإن تغيّر مصدر (اسم ملف، صيغة حقل) تبقى الشاشة كما هي.
       *
       * وما لا يُقرأ لا يُخترع
       * ----------------------
       * كل دالة هنا تُعيد `null` أو قائمة فارغة حين لا مصدر: بلا جلسة تطبيق مسجَّلة لا مشهد تطبيق،
       * وبلا أقفال لا مشهد يدوي. وهذا ما يمنع لوحةً تقول «تمّ» لشيء لم يُقس أصلًا — وهو العطب الذي
       * وُلدت اللوحة لتمنعه.
       *
       * والأسماء تبقى كما كتبها المصدر: `perf_lite_mode` أو `applied` لا تُترجم هنا؛ الترجمة للعرض
       * في `StoryboardHome` (جدول واحد)، وهذا الملف ينقل القيمة لا معناها.
       */
      package nd.max.ui.util
      
      import android.content.Context
      import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
      import nd.max.MaxManagerPaths
      import nd.max.core.hardware.ManualControlLocks
      import nd.max.core.hardware.PerAppHardwareStatus
      import nd.max.core.hardware.RootFileAccess
      import nd.max.ui.mainscreens.CpuPolicyChoice
      import nd.max.ui.mainscreens.ManualSceneInput
      import nd.max.ui.mainscreens.MeasuredOutcome
      import nd.max.ui.mainscreens.PerAppSceneInput
      import nd.max.ui.mainscreens.StoryboardModel
      import nd.max.ui.mainscreens.StoryboardScene
      
      /**
       * قراءة حيّة للوحة. تُنادى من الشاشة الرئيسية بدورة بطيئة (١٠ ثوانٍ) لا كل ثانيتين: ما يعرضه
       * هو **نتيجة اختيار** يتغيّر عند فتح تطبيق أو قفل مقبض، لا قياس لحظي يتحرّك كل نبضة.
       */
      object StoryboardSources {
      
          private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
      
          /** المشهدان اللذان لا يملكهما الـViewModel: التطبيق، وتحكّمك اليدوي. */
          fun scenes(context: Context): List<StoryboardScene> =
              listOfNotNull(perAppScene(context), manualScene())
      
          /**
           * مشهد آخر جلسة تطبيق — من **سجل نتائج العتاد** الذي كتبه مراقب الخلفية.
           *
           * والسجل يبقى بعد الخروج من التطبيق (يُصفَّر عند إقلاع المراقب وحده)، فمن فتح الرئيسية بعد
           * لعبة عليه `gaming` يرى ما وقع فيها — لا ما يظنّه وقع. ووقت القياس من الملف نفسه (`at`)
           * لا ساعة الواجهة.
           */
          fun perAppScene(context: Context): StoryboardScene? {
              val snapshot = runCatching { PerAppHardwareStatus.read() }.getOrNull() ?: return null
              if (snapshot.pkg.isBlank()) return null
              val config = readConfig(snapshot.pkg)
              return StoryboardModel.perAppScene(
                  PerAppSceneInput(
                      packageName = snapshot.pkg,
                      appLabel = appLabel(context, snapshot.pkg),
                      // نفس احتياط شاشة إعدادات التطبيق: الإعدادات القديمة حملت `thermal_profile`
                      // وحده، فقراءة `gpu_profile` وحدها تُظهر «لا شيء» لاختيارٍ قائم — واللوحة تصير
                      // كذبة بسبب رحلة بيانات لا بسبب اختيار.
                      profile = config?.gpu_profile?.takeIf { it != "default" }
                          ?: config?.thermal_profile
                          ?: "default",
                      cpuPolicies = config?.cpu_policy_controls?.let(::cpuPolicyChoices).orEmpty(),
                      killsBackground = config?.kill_bg_apps == "true",
                      refreshRate = config?.refresh_rate ?: "default",
                      renderer = config?.renderer ?: "default",
                      cpuGovernor = config?.cpu_governor ?: "default",
                      gpuGovernor = config?.gpu_governor ?: "default",
                      gpuMaxFreq = config?.gpu_max_freq ?: "default",
                      outcomes = snapshot.records.map { record ->
                          MeasuredOutcome(
                              knob = record.knob,
                              outcome = record.outcome,
                              reason = record.reason,
                              // القيم الخام من العتاد تُعرض بتردّدها المقروء: `1300000000` وحدها
                              // تبدو معرّفًا لا سرعة، والرقم واحد في الحالتين.
                              expected = StoryboardModel.readableValue(record.expected),
                              live = StoryboardModel.readableValue(record.live),
                          )
                      },
                      measuredAtMs = snapshot.atMs.takeIf { it > 0L },
                  ),
              )
          }
      
          /**
           * مشهد التحكّم اليدوي — من **أقفال المستخدم** الدائمة، لا من ذاكرة الواجهة: قفلٌ بعد إعادة
           * إقلاع التطبيق يبقى مقفلًا على العتاد، فيجب أن يبقى معروضًا هنا («هل نسيتُ أن أطفئه؟»).
           */
          fun manualScene(): StoryboardScene? {
              val locks = runCatching { ManualControlLocks.snapshot() }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
              if (locks.isEmpty()) return null
              return StoryboardModel.manualScene(
                  locks.map { lock ->
                      ManualSceneInput(
                          knob = lock.key,
                          from = lock.baseline?.takeIf(String::isNotBlank)?.let(StoryboardModel::readableValue),
                          to = StoryboardModel.readableValue(lock.desired),
                          verified = true,
                      )
                  },
              )
          }
      
          /** اختياراتك لسياسات CPU: فكّ ترميز ملف الإعدادات إلى أنواع اللوحة، مع اسم العنقود. */
          private fun cpuPolicyChoices(encoded: String): List<CpuPolicyChoice> {
              val controls = decodePerAppCpuPolicyControls(encoded)
              if (controls.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
              // أسماء العناقيد تُقرأ فقط حين توجد سياسات مضبوطة، فلا تُدفع كلفة اكتشاف العناقيد في
              // الحالة الشائعة (تطبيق بلا ضبط CPU).
              val tags = runCatching {
                  CpuTopologyUtil.detectClusters().associate { cluster ->
                      cluster.policyPath.substringAfterLast('/') to cluster.shortTag
                  }
              }.getOrDefault(emptyMap())
              return controls.map { control ->
                  CpuPolicyChoice(
                      policyName = control.policyName,
                      label = tags[control.policyName] ?: control.policyName.uppercase(),
                      minKHz = control.minKHz,
                      maxKHz = control.maxKHz,
                  )
              }
          }
      
          /** إعدادات تطبيق واحد من ملف اختياراتك؛ `null` حين لا مدخل له (تطبيق غير مُدار). */
          private fun readConfig(packageName: String): AppConfig? = try {
              // نفس قراءة شاشة قائمة التطبيقات: مصدر واحد للإعدادات، فلا تفسيران مختلفان للملف.
              val content = RootFileAccess.read(MaxManagerPaths.APPLIST_JSON)
              if (content.isNullOrBlank()) null
              else json.decodeFromString<Map<String, AppConfig>>(content)[packageName]
          } catch (_: Exception) {
              // ملف تالف أو حزمة أُزيلت: لا مشهد تطبيق، بلا إسقاط الشاشة.
              null
          }
      
          /**
           * اسم التطبيق كما يعرضه المشغّل. وعند تعذّره (حزمة أُزيلت بعد جلسة قديمة) يبقى اسم الحزمة:
           * إظهار `com.x.y` أوضح من إظهار سطر بلا اسم.
           */
          private fun appLabel(context: Context, packageName: String): String = runCatching {
              val pm = context.packageManager
              pm.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0).loadLabel(pm).toString()
          }.getOrDefault(packageName)
      }
```

> **B. GamePanelService idle cost:**
> - Add a screen-state receiver to suspend polling while the screen is off (0 wakeups) instead of every 10s.

> - Most importantly: **increase `FOREGROUND_TTL_MS`** and make poll interval > TTL so every poll does at most one shell call; currently TTL 2s == idle poll 2s so nearly every poll. With poll 2.5s it's still every poll. Setting TTL 5s means at most one shell per 5s even if polls at 2s — but then a game switch can be detected up to 5s late. Active poll 1.5s needs TTL <= 1.5s for accurate start detection. Hmm. Better: keep TTL 1.5s for active, but when idle, query is the same. Alternatively use the AppMonitor companion's detected switch event to wake the panel (it already starts the service on game switch). Detection latency when launching a game from the launcher: the companion detects within 1s and sends `am start-foreground-service`; the panel service may already be in a 2s sleep, so up to 2s. Fine.

That would fight battery saver. **Add**: in `cycle()`, read `PowerManager.isPowerSaveMode`; if on, override objective to ECO (and skip exploration). > _Reasoning_
> This looks correct for mode persistence: `setAiEnabled(true)` reads `max_ai_mode` and applies it; `standDown` reads intent. So Battery not overwritten by Balanced.
> 
> But: `setObjectivePreference` calls `ProfileApplier.apply(profileId)` when AI is **off**. The CLI, with `!from_ai`, writes `max_ai_mode` too. Since profileId is the new chosen mode, it's fine. But wait: if AI is off and the user changes the mode, `apply` is manual and writes `MAX_AI_MODE` via C — same value. Fine.
> 
> Potential issue: **`ProfileApplier.apply` runs a shell command and blocks?** In `setObjectivePreference` it's called on a coroutine (scope.launch? It's a normal function, so on the caller thread = UI thread!). `setObjectivePreference` is called from the UI (button), runs `MaxAiMode.write` (file I/O), `PropertyUtils.set`, `ProfileApplier.apply` (shell command!) **on the caller thread**. If that's the main thread, it will block the UI for the duration of the shell command (potentially 100ms+). Let me check `setObjectivePreference` callers; it's a public function called from UI. `ProfileApplier.apply` likely uses `RootShell.exec` blocking. That's a main-thread I/O violation (item 10), causing jank. Also `announceUserObjectiveNow` uses `runCatching { MaxManagerReceiver.refreshProfileCard }` on the caller thread.
>

```
      /**
       * تطبيق ملفات الأداء العامة (performance / balanced / eco) عبر خدمة
       * الوحدة الحقيقية sys.maxmanager-service — نفس المسار الذي يستخدمه

       * هذه هي الطريقة الوحيدة الصحيحة لتبديل الملف العام: الوحدة الأصلية
       * تدير المحافظ والحدود و I/O وغيرها كوحدة واحدة، فأي كتابة مباشرة
       * منفصلة كانت ستتصارع معها.
       */
      object ProfileApplier {
      
          const val PROFILE_PERFORMANCE = "1"
          const val PROFILE_BALANCED = "2"
          const val PROFILE_ECO = "3"
      
          // نفس مسار ملف الملف الحالي الذي يراقبه RootUtils (observeProfileRes)
          // عبر FileObserver — الكتابة هنا تُحدِّث شارة الملف في الواجهة تلقائيًا.
          private const val DAEMON_PROFILE_PATH = "/data/adb/.config/MaxManager/API/current_profile"
      
          /**
           * يطبّق ملفًا عامًا. يعيد true فقط عندما تنجح الخدمة فعليًا.
           *
           * @param profileId "1" أداء / "2" متوازن / "3" توفير طاقة
           */
          fun apply(profileId: String): Boolean {
              if (profileId !in listOf(PROFILE_PERFORMANCE, PROFILE_BALANCED, PROFILE_ECO)) {
                  return false
              }
              return runService(profileId, fromAi = false)
          }
      
          /**
           * مسار محرك MAX AI ومحرك الأمان: نفس الخدمة، بعلم --from-ai الذي
           * يتيح لها التطبيق أثناء تفعيل AI — بوابة الوحدة ترفض المسار
           * اليدوي فقط (الاختيار اليدوي أثناء AI يُحفظ معلقًا في التطبيق
           * بدل التنفيذ، فلا يتصارع مالكان على الملف).
           */
          fun applyFromAi(profileId: String): Boolean {
              if (profileId !in listOf(PROFILE_PERFORMANCE, PROFILE_BALANCED, PROFILE_ECO)) {
                  return false
              }
              return runService(profileId, fromAi = true)
          }
      
          private fun runService(profileId: String, fromAi: Boolean): Boolean {
              val serviceBin = SuFile(MaxManagerPaths.SERVICE_BIN)
              if (!serviceBin.exists()) {
                  // الوحدة مثبتة لكن خدمتها غير موجودة — أثر بالغ الأهمية في
                  // التشخيص: كل تبديل ملف من الواجهة يفشل بصمت خلافًا لذلك.
                  DiagnosticCenter.record(
                      "profile",
                      "service binary missing at ${MaxManagerPaths.SERVICE_BIN}",
                      level = DiagnosticCenter.Level.ERROR
                  )
                  return false
              }
              val cmd = if (fromAi) {
                  "${MaxManagerPaths.SERVICE_BIN} -p $profileId --from-ai"
              } else {
                  "${MaxManagerPaths.SERVICE_BIN} -p $profileId"
              }
              val result = Shell.cmd(cmd).exec()
              if (!result.isSuccess) {
                  DiagnosticCenter.record(
                      "profile",
                      "apply profileId=$profileId fromAi=$fromAi failed via module service" +
                          (result.err.take(3).joinToString(" ").take(160)).let { if (it.isBlank()) "" else " :: $it" }

          fun persistMaxAiMode(profileId: String): Boolean {
              if (profileId !in listOf(PROFILE_PERFORMANCE, PROFILE_BALANCED, PROFILE_ECO)) {
                  return false
              }
              return RootFileAccess.write(MaxManagerPaths.MAX_AI_MODE, "$profileId\n")
          }
      
          /** الملف العام الحالي من ملف الوحدة، أو null عند تعذّر القراءة. */
          fun currentProfile(): String? = RootFileAccess.read(DAEMON_PROFILE_PATH)
      }
```

> ### Change 7 — Daemon: don't re-apply performance/eco when already in the mode
> `apply_eco_profile` and `apply_balanced_profile` have guards; `apply_performance_profile` has a guard that is bypassed when `need_profile_checkup` is true. The checkup branch sets need=false only when the current mode isn't BALANCED/ECO. Then calls apply_performance_profile **even when no game is focused**. This is the bug that could switch the whole system to Performance on any `app_status` write while the base mode is BALANCED/ECO. Let's re-derive carefully with base=BALANCED (max_ai_mode=2), AI on, no game:
> 
> - Boot: cur_mode=0, need=true at boot? `ctx.need_profile_checkup = true;` yes. checkup branch: no game → cur_mode(0) != BALANCED && != ECO → need=false. Then `apply_performance_profile`: guard `is_initialize_complete && cur_mode==PERFORMANCE && !need` → false (cur_mode=0) → **applies PERFORMANCE**! So at boot with base=Balanced and no game, the system goes PERFORMANCE. Then bottom `apply_base_profile` (base=BALANCED) applies Balanced (cur_mode PERFORMANCE → passes guard) → logs BALANCED. So transient performance application of 1-5 seconds at every boot/app restarts. And if `apply_performance_profile`'s profiler is slow, this is a wasted heavy operation at boot; worse, if the daemon crashes mid-way, the device stays at max frequencies.
> 
> - Later, any `app_status` write with base=Balanced and no game: need=true → branch → no game → need=false → apply_performance_profile (cur_mode is BALANCED → applies PERFORMANCE) → bottom apply_base_profile (BALANCED) → applies BALANCED. **Two full profile applications per status write**, and the system briefly goes to max freq. If app_status changes every minute (battery, refresh rate) — heavy.
> 
> This is a definite defect with exactly the symptom (heat spikes, extra CPU, writes). The fix in C: in the no-game branch, don't call `apply_performance_profile`; instead clear the checkup and let the bottom choose the base profile. I.e., restructure:
> 
> ```c
> if (ctx.need_profile_checkup) {
>     ... detect game ...
>     if (found) { ... apply_performance_profile; }
>     else {
>         ... drop state ...
>         ctx.need_profile_checkup = false;  // always
>         // no performance apply
>     }
> }
> ```
> Then the bottom applies `apply_base_profile` (or eco) — one apply only if the mode changed. Guard prevents repeats. This must be done carefully with `goto` labels and screen-off grace.
> 
> The current code: `apply_performance_profile(&ctx);` sits at end of the `if (need_profile_checkup)` block **unconditionally**, even when `current_focused_game == NULL`. We should only call it when a game/`gamestart` is active. After the no-game branch, `gamestart` is NULL, `active_app_name` NULL. So:
> 
> ```c
> if (gamestart != NULL || ctx.need_profile_checkup)  // original intent: focused game
>     apply_performance_profile(&ctx);
> ```
> Wait, when `current_focused_game` is a game, `gamestart` is set. When the focused app is a tracked game but `need_profile_checkup` was set by app_status, we want performance (re)apply. When no game, `gamestart == NULL` → don't apply. So the minimal fix: `if (gamestart) apply_performance_profile(&ctx); else ctx.need_profile_checkup = false;`. And ensure the bottom base/eco path runs. But careful: the `continue` at line ~340: `if (is_initialize_complete && cur_mode != PERFORMANCE && gamestart == NULL && !need) { ...base/eco/continue }`. Since we set need=false, that block runs and applies eco/base. Good.
> 
> But if base mode is PERFORMANCE (cur_mode == PERFORMANCE, gamestart NULL), that `if` is false (cur_mode != PERFORMANCE fails) → bottom `else apply_base_profile` → performance guard returns (mode already). Good. If cur_mode is ECO and base=PERFORMANCE, bottom applies performance (cur_mode != PERF) → correct.

> Even after fix 7, with a game present, each app_status change re-applies performance. The companion writes app_status when battery level changes (cached 2s but level changes slowly) — during a long game session, maybe every few minutes; plus refresh rate changes at game start. 7 applies per session in the log (one session id, but those were across hours and process restarts). After fix 7, target=system applies become base applies (one per restart) — still heavy but not per-second.

Fix: in `InotifyWatcher`, only set `need_profile_checkup` if the **focused app** changed. Parse `focused_app` from the new cache and compare with `last_focused_app` stored in ctx. But ctx has no such field; `gamestart` holds the game package and `current_system_cache.focused_app` holds it. Before `read_app_status`, capture `prev_focused`; after, if `strcmp(prev, new)!=0` set need. But other fields (screen awake, battery saver) drive state too; the main loop reads `ctx` each event anyway (for low power and screen). `need_profile_checkup` is only about the game/profile. So yes: set it only when focused_app changed. However, `app_status` also carries `switch_id`; an app switch where package stays the same (rare) doesn't matter.

> ### Change 10 — Memory
> - `DiagnosticCenter` capped? check.
> - `AppIconCache` 150 entries at 128dp = ~88MB. We can lower the lobby icon raster to 96dp (still 3x for 32dp display?) and make cache key include size to avoid mixing. Lowering to 96dp cuts memory ~44%. But is it worth risk? The lobby displays icons at up to 104dp (EMBLEM_MAX_SIDE) so 128dp is right. 150 × 128dp @3.4x = 435px → 756KB each (ARGB_8888) → 113MB! That's a big chunk of 500MB. But the LRU 150 only fills as many distinct games as viewed. Still, could be 20-40MB.
> - `AppIconCache` keys by package only; if the first load is 40dp (57KB) then the lobby reuses the low-res icon and looks blurry (or vice versa). Since both use the same key, whichever first wins — the lobby might get a 40dp icon scaled up. Not a leak, but a bug. Fix: key by `pkg@px`. That **increases** memory though. Better not.

```
          enum class Level(val daemonLevel: Int) { INFO(1), WARN(2), ERROR(3) }
      
          private class DiagEntry(

              val level: Level,
              val message: String,
              val firstTimeMs: Long,

              var count: Int = 1

          private const val MAX_ENTRIES = 64
          private const val MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS = 240

          /** عدد المشاكل المميزة (WARN/ERROR) — تعرضه شاشة الإعدادات كمؤشر. */

          val issueCount: StateFlow<Int> = _issueCount.asStateFlow()
      
          /**

           *
           * @param component المصدر: "jni"، "engine"، "learning"، "profile"...
           * @param message وصف قصير ثابت الصياغة (ثبات الصياغة هو ما يجعل

                      // وليس مع كل تسجيل متكرر: التكرار اللانهائي يكلف
                      // مسحًا واحدًا وعدّادًا فقط، بلا أي عمل إضافي.
                      _issueCount.value = entries.count { it.level != Level.INFO }
                      forwardNow = level != Level.INFO
                  }
              }
      
              // التحويل لأول ظهور فقط: العطل المزمن يكتب سطرًا واحدًا في ملف
              // الوحدة بدل مئات الأصفار — والعدّاد في الذاكرة يحمل التكرار.
              if (forwardNow) {
                  forwardToDaemonLog(component, level, msg)
              }
          }
      
          fun hasIssues(): Boolean = synchronized(lock) {
              entries.any { it.level != Level.INFO }
          }
      
          /**
           * A structured entry as a **report** may carry it (`P6`/`T6.7`).
           *
           * There is deliberately no message field. A message is free text a caller interpolated, so it can
           * contain a path, a package name, an account id or anything else that happened to be in scope at
           * the failure site; a diagnostic report is the last place that should become a channel for those.
           * Component, level and count answer "what failed, how badly, how often" without carrying content.
           */
          data class StructuredEntry(
              val component: String,
              val level: Level,
              val count: Int,
              val firstSeenMs: Long,
              val lastSeenMs: Long,
          )
      
          /** The whole allowlisted projection, ordered from the most recent failure backwards. */
          data class StructuredSummary(
              val entries: List<StructuredEntry>,
              val warnCount: Int,
              val errorCount: Int,
              val distinctComponents: Int,
          )
      
          /**
           * The allowlisted projection of this session's ring buffer.
           *
           * Distinct from [formatBlock], which exists for a human reading a log and includes messages. This
           * one exists for a report that may leave the device, so it exposes only component names (which the
           * codebase's own call sites define) and counts.
           */
          fun structured(): StructuredSummary = synchronized(lock) {
              val projected = entries.map { entry ->
                  StructuredEntry(
                      component = entry.component,
                      level = entry.level,
                      count = entry.count,
                      firstSeenMs = entry.firstTimeMs,
                      lastSeenMs = entry.lastTimeMs,
                  )
              }.sortedByDescending { it.lastSeenMs }
              StructuredSummary(
                  entries = projected,
                  warnCount = projected.count { it.level == Level.WARN },
                  errorCount = projected.count { it.level == Level.ERROR },
                  distinctComponents = projected.map { it.component }.distinct().size,
              )
          }
      
          /** الكتلة التي تُدمج في كل تصدير تشخيصي. */
          fun formatBlock(): String = synchronized(lock) {
              val fmt = SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.US)
              buildString {
                  appendLine("--- DIAGNOSTIC CENTER (always-on, in-memory ring) ---")
                  if (entries.isEmpty()) {
                      appendLine("(no issues recorded this session)")
                  } else {
                      entries.forEach { e ->
                          appendLine(
                              "[${e.level}] first=${fmt.format(Date(e.firstTimeMs))} " +
                                  "last=${fmt.format(Date(e.lastTimeMs))} (x${e.count}) " +
                                  "${e.component}: ${e.message}"
                          )
                      }
                  }
              }
          }
      
          private fun forwardToDaemonLog(component: String, level: Level, message: String) {
              // نفس آلية EventLog.forward: fire-and-forget عبر libsu — فشل
              // التسجيل لا يجوز أن يطفو على العملية التي أطلقته.
              runCatching { forwarder(component, level, message) }
          }
      
          /**
           * حاقن التحويل — قابل للاستبدال في اختبارات الوحدة كي لا تحاول
           * بيئة JVM إطلاق shell حقيقي. الإنتاج يستخدم الافتراضي أدناه.
           */
          internal var forwarder: (String, Level, String) -> Unit = { component, level, message ->
              Shell.cmd(
                  "'${MaxManagerPaths.SERVICE_BIN}' --log 'diag' '${level.daemonLevel}' '${shellSafe(message)}'"
              ).submit()
          }
      
          fun resetForTesting() {
              synchronized(lock) {
                  entries.clear()
              }
              _issueCount.value = 0
          }
      
          private fun shellSafe(value: String): String =
              value.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", "").replace("'", "'\\''")
      }
```

```
      //! معلنة، مدخلات مقيسة، حدود صادقة (مصفوفة فارغة قبل اكتمال النصاب
      /// لا أصفارًا مزيفة).
      
      /// نظام التنبؤ بالقياسات: يحفظ تاريخًا حقيقيًا لثلاثة محاور
      /// (حمل CPU%، حرارة °C، بطارية%) ويستقرئ عليها.
      pub struct PowerPredictor {
          cpu_history: Vec<f32>,
          thermal_history: Vec<f32>,
          battery_history: Vec<f32>,
          max_history: usize,
      }
      
      impl PowerPredictor {
          pub fn new() -> Self {
              Self {
                  cpu_history: Vec::with_capacity(100),
                  thermal_history: Vec::with_capacity(100),
                  battery_history: Vec::with_capacity(100),
                  max_history: 100,
              }
          }
      
          /// تحديث التواريخ الثلاثة بقياسات حقيقية. (الحرارة والبطارية كانت
          /// تُقبلان وتُرميان في النسخة القديمة — الآن تُسجلان فعليًا.)
          pub fn update(&mut self, cpu_load: f32, thermal: f32, battery: f32) {
              push_capped(&mut self.cpu_history, cpu_load, self.max_history);
              push_capped(&mut self.thermal_history, thermal, self.max_history);
              push_capped(&mut self.battery_history, battery, self.max_history);
          }
      
          /// تنبؤ حراري لعدد خطوات قادمة: استقراء موزون فوق التاريخ الحراري

          /// كي يتدخل قبل تجاوز الحد لا بعده.
          pub fn predict_thermal(&self, steps: usize) -> Vec<f32> {
              if steps == 0 {
                  return Vec::new();
              }
              weighted_forecast(&self.thermal_history, steps)
          }
      
          /// تنبؤ حمل CPU — نفس المنهج فوق تاريخ الحمل المقيس.

          /// وسطرها هنا إقرارٌ بالحالة لا ادّعاءُ استخدام.
          #[allow(dead_code)]
          pub fn predict_cpu(&self, steps: usize) -> Vec<f32> {
              if steps == 0 {
                  return Vec::new();
              }
              weighted_forecast(&self.cpu_history, steps)
          }
      
          /// عدد قراءات التاريخ الحراري المتوفرة — أساس حارس النصاب في الاختبارات.

          /// بصدق») كان ادّعاءً غير صحيح — Kotlin لا يرى هذه الأعداد إطلاقًا (`I-77`).
          #[cfg(test)]
          pub fn thermal_samples(&self) -> usize {
              self.thermal_history.len()
          }
      
          /// عدد قراءات تاريخ الحمل المتوفرة — للاختبار وحده (السبب أعلاه).
          #[cfg(test)]
          pub fn cpu_samples(&self) -> usize {

          #[cfg(test)]
          pub fn battery_samples(&self) -> usize {
              self.battery_history.len()
          }
      }
      
      fn push_capped(v: &mut Vec<f32>, value: f32, cap: usize) {
          if !value.is_finite() {
              return; // لا ندخل NaN/inf في التاريخ أصلًا
          }
          v.push(value);
          if v.len() > cap {
              v.remove(0);
          }
      }
```

```
      import nd.max.core.privilege.ExecutionMode
      import nd.max.core.privilege.ExecutionModeStore
      import nd.max.ui.util.AppConfig
      
      /** Process singleton shared even by non-Hilt legacy ViewModels. AppMonitor reads this same file. */
      object GameProfileRepository {
          data class State(val profiles: Map<String, AppConfig> = emptyMap(), val loading: Boolean = true,
              val failed: Boolean = false, val revision: Long = 0)
          private val mutable = MutableStateFlow(State())
          val state = mutable.asStateFlow()
          private val mutex = Mutex()
          private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; encodeDefaults = true }
          private val path get() = MaxManagerPaths.APPLIST_JSON
      
          /** مسار الملف المحلي (داخل التطبيق) — يُضبط من `install` عند الإقلاع. */
          @Volatile private var localFile: File? = null
      
          /** وثيقة المالك الجذري: يقرؤها `AppMonitor` نفسها (لا قاعدة بيانات موازية). */
          private val rootIo = object : GameProfilePersistence.Io {
              override fun read() = RootFileAccess.read(path)
              override fun write(text: String) = RootFileAccess.atomicWriteText(path, text)
          }
      
          /**
           * وثيقة بلا جذر: ملفّ في `filesDir` **بالتنسيق نفسه**، كتابة ذرّية (مؤقّت ثم إعادة تسمية). الغياب = وثيقة فارغة
           * لا فشل (أول استعمال)، بخلاف الجذري الذي غيابه عطب.
           */
          private val localIo = object : GameProfilePersistence.Io {
              override fun read(): String? {
                  val file = localFile ?: return null
                  return if (file.isFile) runCatching { file.readText() }.getOrNull() else "{}"
              }
      
              override fun write(text: String): Boolean {
                  val file = localFile ?: return false
                  return runCatching {
                      val temp = File(file.parentFile, file.name + ".tmp")
                      temp.writeText(text)
                      temp.renameTo(file)
                  }.getOrDefault(false)
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * من يملك الوثيقة؟ **الجذر** في ROOT، وفي AUTO ما لم يثبت غيابه (`false` صريح — المجهول يُعامَل جذرًا حتى لا
           * يتغيّر سلوك من لديه جذر لم تُسخَّن صدفته بعد). وفي SHIZUKU وBASIC: الملف المحلي، فلا نافذة `su` ولا فشل.
           */
          private fun usesRootDocument(): Boolean = when (ExecutionModeStore.current()) {
              ExecutionMode.ROOT -> true
              ExecutionMode.AUTO -> runCatching { Shell.isAppGrantedRoot() != false }.getOrDefault(true)
              ExecutionMode.SHIZUKU, ExecutionMode.BASIC -> false
          }
      
          private fun io(): GameProfilePersistence.Io = if (usesRootDocument()) rootIo else localIo
      
          /** يُنادى مرة عند الإقلاع: يحدّد مكان الملف المحلي. */
          fun install(context: Context) {
              localFile = File(context.applicationContext.filesDir, LOCAL_FILE_NAME)
          }
      
          private val persistence = GameProfilePersistence(object : GameProfilePersistence.Io {
              override fun read() = io().read()
              override fun write(text: String) = io().write(text)
          }, validate = { document -> document.values.forEach { json.decodeFromString<AppConfig>(it.toString()) } })
      
          suspend fun load() = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
              mutex.withLock {
                  try { publish(readDocument()) }
                  catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
                  catch (_: Exception) { mutable.value = mutable.value.copy(loading = false, failed = true) }
              }
          }
      
          /** Resolve against disk under the common lock, not a caller's stale Map snapshot. */
          suspend fun update(pkg: String, transform: (AppConfig?) -> AppConfig?): Boolean = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
              if (!ForegroundAppResolver.isPackageName(pkg)) return@withContext false
              mutex.withLock {
                  try {
                      val result = persistence.update(pkg) { fields ->
                          val current = fields?.let { migrate(json.decodeFromString<AppConfig>(it.toString())) }
                          transform(current)?.let { json.parseToJsonElement(json.encodeToString(it)) as JsonObject }
                      }
                      if (!result.saved) { loadFailure(result.document); return@withLock false }
                      publish(requireNotNull(result.document))
                      true
                  } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
                  catch (_: Exception) { mutable.value = mutable.value.copy(loading = false, failed = true); false }
              }
          }
      
          private fun readDocument() = GameProfileDocument.parse(io().read() ?: error("profile-document-unreadable"))
          private fun publish(document: JsonObject) {
              val profiles = document.mapValues { (_, value) -> migrate(json.decodeFromString<AppConfig>(value.toString())) }
              mutable.value = State(profiles, loading = false, revision = mutable.value.revision + 1)
          }
          private fun loadFailure(document: JsonObject?) {
              if (document != null) publish(document)
              mutable.value = mutable.value.copy(loading = false, failed = true)
          }
          private fun migrate(config: AppConfig): AppConfig =
              if (config.gpu_profile == "default" && config.thermal_profile != "default") config.copy(
                  gpu_profile = if (config.thermal_profile.lowercase() == "powersave") "power" else config.thermal_profile.lowercase(),
                  thermal_profile = "default") else config
      
          private const val LOCAL_FILE_NAME = "applist.local.json"
      }

      /* Copyright (C) 2026 Nader Magdy. All rights reserved. */
      package nd.max.core.gamespace
      
      import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
      import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
      import nd.max.core.platform.ForegroundAppResolver
      
      /** The existing AppMonitor applist document, not a new gaming profile database. */
      object GameProfileDocument {
          const val MAX_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024
          const val MAX_APPS = 4096
          private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
      
          fun parse(raw: String): JsonObject {
              require(raw.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_BYTES)
              val document = json.parseToJsonElement(raw) as? JsonObject ?: error("profile-document-not-object")
              require(document.size <= MAX_APPS)
              require(document.all { (pkg, value) -> ForegroundAppResolver.isPackageName(pkg) && value is JsonObject })
              return document
          }
      
          /** An update replaces known fields only; future/foreign per-app fields survive. */
          fun patch(document: JsonObject, pkg: String, knownFields: JsonObject?): JsonObject {
              require(ForegroundAppResolver.isPackageName(pkg))
              val next = document.toMutableMap()
              if (knownFields == null) next.remove(pkg)
              else next[pkg] = JsonObject((document[pkg] as? JsonObject).orEmpty() + knownFields)
              return JsonObject(next).also { parse(it.toString()) }
          }
      }
```
